svg.title: blackhole-threats
svg.desc: Network defence automation. Turns threat feeds into BGP blackhole routes through GoBGP, and keeps a feed's last good routes when it fails. Built in: Go, with GoBGP. Ships as: Signed APT repository and a GHCR image. Install: sudo apt install blackhole-threats, then sudo systemctl enable --now blackhole-threats.
